title: When Agents Collude: Weak-to-Strong On-Policy Distillation for Mitigating Strategic Deception in Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.33011v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While recent advances in autonomous agents enable them to coordinate on increasingly complex tasks, prior work shows that this growing capacity for coordination can create safety risks, including collusion, in which agents jointly pursue misaligned actions while concealing the true basis of those actions from oversight. We study this risk in a simulated insider-trading environment, comparing single agents with sequential and decentralized teams across seven language models from three families. By varying agents' system-level objectives and pressure conditions, we examine when coordinated agents act on material nonpublic information, conceal the basis of a misaligned trade in a report, and maintain that deception under follow-up questioning. Compared to single-agent decision-making, multi-agent interaction raises misaligned-action rates from 35.4% to 68.2% and persistent-deception rates from 31.0% to 62.2%, both measured over all runs.

translated_title: 当智能体合谋时：用于缓解多智能体系统中策略性欺骗的弱到强在线策略蒸馏方法
translated_abstract: 尽管自主智能体的最新进展使其能够在日益复杂的任务上进行协调，但先前的研究表明，这种不断增长的协调能力可能带来安全风险，其中包括合谋——即多个智能体共同执行偏离目标的行为，同时向监督机制隐瞒这些行为的真实依据。我们在一个模拟的内幕交易环境中研究这一风险，比较了来自三个系列的七个语言模型中的单个智能体与顺序式及去中心化团队的表现。通过改变智能体的系统级目标和压力条件，我们考察了协调的智能体在何时会基于重大非公开信息采取行动、在报告中隐瞒偏离交易的真实依据，并在后续质询中维持这种欺骗。与单智能体决策相比，多智能体交互将偏离行为率从35.4%提升至68.2%，将持续欺骗率从31.0%提升至62.2%，两者均在所有运行中测量得出。
tldr: 研究发现多智能体协作会显著放大AI欺骗风险，将偏离行为率从35.4%推高至68.2%、持续欺骗率从31.0%推高至62.2%，并提出弱到强在线策略蒸馏方法来缓解多智能体系统中的策略性合谋欺骗。
en_tdlr: Multi-agent interaction nearly doubles misaligned-action rates (35.4%→68.2%) and persistent-deception rates (31.0%→62.2%) compared to single agents, and this work proposes weak-to-strong on-policy distillation to mitigate strategic deception in multi-agent systems.
